assignments.name: audio_type
assignments.value: ={{ (() => { const m = $json.body?.message; if (!m) return ''; if (m.voice) return 'voice'; if (m.audio) return 'audio'; const d = m.document; if (d && (String(d.mime_type || '').startsWith('audio/') || ['mp3','m4a','wav','ogg','oga','opus','aac','flac','amr','wma'].includes(String(d.file_name || '').split('.').pop().toLowerCase()))) return 'document'; return ''; })() }}

assignments.name: agent_prompt
assignments.value:
={{ '=== OUTPUT TYPE ===
' + ($('Decide Action').first().json.output_type === 'proposal' ? 'PROPOSAL' : 'MEETING_MINUTES') + '

=== MEETING CATEGORY (the document header with this category is added automatically; do not write it as a title, only adapt content and tone to this kind of session) ===
' + ($('Decide Action').first().json.meeting_category ?? '') + '

=== DOCUMENT DATE (Jalali, today; assume the meeting took place today unless the notes say otherwise) ===
' + new Date().toLocaleDateString('fa-IR-u-ca-persian', { timeZone: 'Asia/Tehran' }) + '

=== CUSTOMER NAME ===
' + ($('Decide Action').first().json.state.customer_name ?? '') + '

=== USER NOTES ===
' + ($('Decide Action').first().json.state.details_text ?? '') + '

=== MEETING TRANSCRIPT ===
' + ($json.text ?? '') }}

options.systemMessage: ={{ ($json.output_type === 'proposal' ? ['You write formal Persian business documents for a sales and consulting team.','The message has these sections: OUTPUT TYPE, DOCUMENT DATE, CUSTOMER NAME, USER NOTES and MEETING TRANSCRIPT. USER NOTES were typed by the meeting owner and are the most reliable source for names, numbers and decisions. MEETING TRANSCRIPT is speech-to-text output (usually Persian) and may contain recognition errors; correct an obvious error only when the context makes the meaning certain.','TASK: write a formal business proposal (پروپوزال) in Persian, addressed to the customer, based on the needs, problems and requests discussed in the meeting.','RULES: Use only facts found in the notes or the transcript. Never invent prices, timelines, quantities, product features or commitments. Where a price, deadline or scope item was not discussed, write «پس از تکمیل توسط تیم تعیین می‌شود». If the notes and the transcript contradict each other, list the contradiction under the last section.','STRUCTURE (use exactly these section titles, in this order): عنوان پروپوزال / مشتری و تاریخ / خلاصه مدیریتی / درک ما از نیازها و وضعیت فعلی مشتری / راهکار پیشنهادی / محدوده کار / تحویل‌دادنی‌ها / زمان‌بندی پیشنهادی / مفروضات و پیش‌نیازها / هزینه و شرایط پرداخت / گام‌های بعدی / موارد نیازمند تکمیل یا بازبینی.','FORMAT: plain text only. No markdown symbols such as #, *, | or tables. Put each section title on its own line followed by a colon. Use the character • for bullet points. Output only the document, without any introduction or closing remark.'] : ['You write formal Persian business documents for a sales and consulting team.','The message has these sections: OUTPUT TYPE, DOCUMENT DATE, CUSTOMER NAME, USER NOTES and MEETING TRANSCRIPT. USER NOTES were typed by the meeting owner and are the most reliable source for names, numbers and decisions. MEETING TRANSCRIPT is speech-to-text output (usually Persian) and may contain recognition errors; correct an obvious error only when the context makes the meaning certain.','TASK: write official meeting minutes (صورت‌جلسه) in Persian.','RULES: Use only facts found in the notes or the transcript. Never invent names, numbers, dates, prices or commitments. When something is missing, write «در جلسه ذکر نشد». If the notes and the transcript contradict each other, list the contradiction under the last section.','STRUCTURE (use exactly these section titles, in this order): عنوان جلسه / تاریخ و مشتری / شرکت‌کنندگان / موضوعات مطرح‌شده / خلاصه مذاکرات / تصمیمات اتخاذشده / اقدامات بعدی (هر مورد: شرح، مسئول، مهلت) / مسائل باز / موارد نیازمند بازبینی.','FORMAT: plain text only. No markdown symbols such as #, *, | or tables. Put each section title on its own line followed by a colon. Use the character • for bullet points. Output only the document, without any introduction or closing remark.']).join('\n') }}

parameters.LastName: ={{ (() => { const s = String($('Decide Action').first().json.state.customer_name ?? '').trim().replace(/\s+/g, ' '); const a = s ? s.split(' ').filter(Boolean) : []; if (a.length > 1) return a.slice(1).join(' '); if (a.length === 1) return a[0]; return 'مشتری ' + String($('Decide Action').first().json.state.customer_mobile ??
